title: cmk.yaml
description: Project configuration for cmk-managed CMake builds.

toolchain.description: clangup toolchain selectors by host platform. Exact os-arch keys override OS keys, then default.

cmake.description: CMake configure presets, multi-config configurations, cache variables, and generator settings.

version.description: Managed CMake version downloaded from upstream Kitware releases. When omitted, cmk uses cmake from PATH.

ninja.description: Managed Ninja version downloaded from clangup R2 tool releases. When omitted, cmk uses ninja from PATH.

generator.description: Default CMake generator (defaults to Ninja Multi-Config).

default-configuration.description: Default configuration for multi-config presets (defaults to the first entry in configurations).

compile-commands.description: Configuration whose compile_commands.json is mirrored into the project root (default, none, or a configured configuration name).

user-presets.description: Generate CMakeUserPresets.json in the project root during configure.

launcher.description: Compiler launcher injected as CMAKE_<LANG>_COMPILER_LAUNCHER when found on PATH.

configurations.description: Configurations exposed by multi-config presets (defaults to Debug and Release).

dependencies.description: External dependencies built into the content-addressed store via project-owned Bash recipes.

rust.description: In-tree Rust staticlib crates built by cmk via Cargo and exported to CMake as find_package() targets.

env.description: Environment variables exported to project commands. Supports ${PROJECT_ROOT} expansion.

target-env.description: Target-specific environment variables applied during cmk run <target>.

command.description: Custom clang-format executable path (absolute or project-relative).

ignore.description: Project-relative globs excluded from cmk fmt.

command.description: Custom clang-tidy executable path (absolute or project-relative).

ignore.description: Project-relative globs excluded from cmk lint.

header-filter.description: Regular expression passed as -header-filter to clang-tidy.

extra-args.description: Additional compiler flags passed to clang-tidy via --extra-arg.

toolchainSelector.description: clangup channel (e.g. default, libcxx, libcxx-pgo) or exact release (e.g. libcxx@23.1.5-1).

cmakeArgs.description: Additional CMake configure arguments (excluding -S, -B, -G, --preset, --fresh, and cmk-owned cache variables).

build-dir.description: Build directory path (defaults to build/<preset>, or build for default).

inherits.description: Parent preset name to inherit generator, build-type, variables, and args from.

generator.description: CMake generator override for this preset.

compile.description: Common C and C++ compile flags for this configuration.

c.description: C-only compile flags for this configuration.

cxx.description: C++-only compile flags for this configuration.

link.description: Linker flags for executables, shared libraries, and modules in this configuration.

script.description: Project-relative path to the Bash build recipe.

needs.description: Names of other cmk dependencies consumed by this recipe.

cmake-name.description: CMake package name exported as -D<cmake-name>_ROOT=<prefix> (defaults to dependency name).

env.description: Environment variables exported to the recipe and included in its store identity.

patches.description: Project-relative patch file globs applied to source before running script.

extra-inputs.description: Project-relative file globs whose contents participate in the dependency store identity.

rustCrate.description: In-tree Rust staticlib crate managed by cmk and exposed via <cmake-name>Config.cmake.

manifest.description: Path to Cargo.toml (relative to project root or absolute).

package.description: Cargo package name passed to --package (defaults to the rust key name).

lib-name.description: Staticlib base name without lib prefix or .a/.lib suffix (defaults to package name with '-' replaced by '_').

cmake-name.description: CMake package and target name exported as <cmake-name>::<cmake-name> (defaults to the rust key name).

target.description: Explicit Rust target triple passed to --target.

cxxbridge.description: Export CXXBRIDGE_OUT_DIR to build.rs and expose generated include/ and bridge.cc via <cmake-name>Config.cmake.

env.description: Extra environment variables passed to cargo build.

source.description: Immutable dependency source: either an archive URL (with optional sha256) or a Git repository with ref.

sha256.description: Optional lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 digest (pinned in cmk.lock when omitted).

ref.description: Git tag, branch, or commit SHA (resolved commit is pinned in cmk.lock).
